kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-list --lang zh --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --firewall-switch-status opened --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --vpc-firewall-name test-vpc-firewall --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --connect-sub-type vpcpeer --peer-uid 2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions where Cloud Firewall is supported, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

> 关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **opened**: The firewall is enabled.

- **closed**: The firewall is disabled.

- **notconfigured**: The firewall is not configured.

- **configured**: The firewall is configured.

> If you do not specify this parameter, VPC firewalls in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：

- **opened**：已开启。
- **closed**：已关闭。
- **notconfigured**：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙。
- **configured**：表示已配置VPC边界防火墙。

> 不设置该参数表示查询所有状态的VPC边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_switch_status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_name

parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。

默认值为**1**，表示返回第**1**页数据
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: **10**. Maximum value: **50**
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含VPC边界防火墙的数量。

默认值为**10**，表示每页包含**10**条结果。最大值为**50**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the connection. Valid values:

- **vpc2vpc**: Express Connect.

- **vpcpeer**: peering connection
parameters.help_zh:
连接子类型。取值：

- **vpc2vpc**：高速通道。
- **vpcpeer**：对等连接
parameters.name: connect_sub_type

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the peer VPC belongs
parameters.name: peer_uid
